stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: The cumulative requests minus returns minus initial stock is the net deficit. Its positive part is exactly the number waiting, so total waiting time is its area over consecutive event intervals. A positive final deficit gives infinite waiting. Sort deficit levels and precompute suffix duration and deficit-duration sums to evaluate each stock query in logarithmic time. Earlier surplus is retained; no artificial clipping of cumulative balance occurs.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
